newsitem.title: USA: New Equal ad campaign moves away from celebrities.
newsitem.headline: New Equal ad campaign moves away from celebrities.

text.p: A new advertising campaign for Equal Sweetener will move away from young celebrities and instead focus on women's broad array of defining characteristics, the company that makes the product said. "We wanted to jump-start the Equal brand and move it to a higher ground," said Mary Rose Neises, Equal Brand Director for Benevia, a unit of Monsanto, which markets Equal. The new campaign, "We May Be Different, But We're All Equal," includes two 30 second television spots. One, which debuted Thursday, features women of different generations and ethnicities, the company said. A second, to be released in March, features a cafe backdrop with Equal being used by a variety of women, men and children in a variety of ways. The campaign was developed by Young & Rubicam. The cost of the campaign was not disclosed. ((Chicago newsdesk, 312-408-8787))
